name: Dodge City (United States)
description: Yellow field with a horizontal stripe of white and black through the centre, charged with a black star within a black ring.
history: Dodge City is a city in and the county seat of Ford County, Kansas. The flag was adopted in 2021 (chosen by a public vote of citizens that closed on 31 March 2021 and approved by the city in April 2021, according to Flags of the World citing the Dodge City Daily Globe).

features.role: horizontal stripe of white and black through the centre
